import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.InputMismatchException;

public class VanyaAndScales {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FasterScanner sc = new FasterScanner();
        int W = sc.nextInt();
        int M = sc.nextInt();

        int[] B = new int[101];
        decompose(B, M, W, 0);
        carry(B, W, 0);

        if (isPossible(B)) {
            System.out.println("YES");
        } else {
            System.out.println("NO");
        }
    }

    private static void decompose(int[] B, int value, int base, int index) {
        if (index == 100) {
            return;
        }
        B[index] = value % base;
        decompose(B, value / base, base, index + 1);
    }

    private static void carry(int[] B, int base, int index) {
        if (index == 100) {
            return;
        }
        if (B[index] > 1) {
            B[index] -= base;
            B[index + 1]++;
        }
        carry(B, base, index + 1);
    }

    private static boolean isPossible(int[] B) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            if (B[i] < -1 || B[i] > 1) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

        private int curChar;
        private int numChars;

        public int read() {
            if (numChars == -1)
                throw new InputMismatchException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = System.in.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                if (numChars <= 0)
                    return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];

            return res.toString();
        }
